data.title: 诀 · 晚风竹院回廊灯下小驻
data.action: 轻倚竹院木栏在暖灯晚风中回首浅笑
data.lighting: 廊下纸灯笼柔暖微光与清凉月色
data.description: 雅集散场后，晚风拂过院外成片修竹发出沙沙轻响。换上月白青竹改良旗袍的李织烟停步在木质回廊栏杆边，青色轻纱披肩随风滑过手肘。平日总显得疏离克制的队长此刻眼神温润，轻轻朝你抬手——「夜风正好，陪我多站片刻吧。」
data.promptProse: Resting lightly against a dark wooden corridor railing beside a moonlit bamboo courtyard, Arcane wears a moon-white silk qipao and sheer celadon shawl, turning toward the viewer in the soft glow of paper lanterns.
data.animaCaption: She rests lightly by the wooden corridor railing with warm lanterns and moonlit bamboo behind her, offering a graceful quiet smile.
